_doc: vt350#220 AC3: the licence of every part a viewer export may contain. The first rule that matches a part gives its licence (platform/viewer/rules.py); a part no rule matches, one whose rule says 'unknown' (an open question, asked in its 'source'), or one whose licence isn't in 'shareable' fails the check. 'source' says where the licence was read. A whole-printer export is checked on the part indexes of lite-N and its extras (cad/viewer/pages.py). Licences of the printed parts: parts/printed/README.md.
